summary: Three independent frontend runs reached the public app and exercised the seeded workout and editor flows. The union found one critical integration defect: finishing a workout with completed sets clears the session before WorkoutModeView can render the required session-summary dialog, leaving the user without volume, PR details, exercise rows, or the required close-to-home action. Two minor UI/code-quality issues were also reported: the frontend lint check fails in shared calendar/command UI components (with additional unused disable warnings), and StoreContext's theme effect emits a missing-dependency warning. Progressive overload, live drag reordering with required handles and no legacy arrows, workout navigation, rest timer, seeded data, and core workout/editor controls were observed working; some reload persistence and full CRUD/second-session assertions were not reachable because the mandated concurrent runs shared IndexedDB/browser state.

ui_bugs.title: Frontend lint fails in shared UI components
ui_bugs.steps_to_reproduce: Run the configured JavaScript lint check against /app/frontend/src.
ui_bugs.actual: Lint reports react/no-unstable-nested-components twice in calendar.jsx, react/no-unknown-property for cmdk-input-wrapper in command.jsx, and unused eslint-disable directives in PlanEditorView.js, WorkoutModeView.js, and StoreContext.js.
ui_bugs.impact: CI/lint checks fail even though the app compiles and the affected controls were not observed to crash.

ui_bugs.title: Store theme effect emits a React hooks dependency warning
ui_bugs.steps_to_reproduce: Load the app and inspect the frontend development log, or run the frontend dev server.
ui_bugs.expected: No React hooks warnings during normal app load.
ui_bugs.actual: Frontend log reports that the theme useEffect has a missing state dependency; the nearby eslint-disable directive is also reported as unused by lint.
ui_bugs.impact: Non-blocking runtime noise and reduced confidence in effect dependency correctness.

integration_issues.title: Session summary dialog never appears after finishing a session with completed sets
integration_issues.location: WorkoutModeView.js early return and finish-session flow
integration_issues.steps_to_reproduce: Open the seeded A · Spinta workout, fill at least one set such as 60 kg x 10 reps, mark the set complete, then click [data-testid=finish-session-secondary] or [data-testid=finish-session-button]. Query [data-testid=session-summary-dialog] after finish completes.
integration_issues.expected: A visible dialog should appear with [data-testid=summary-total-volume], [data-testid=summary-pr-count], summary-exercise-* rows and PR badges when applicable, plus [data-testid=summary-close-button] that returns to home.
integration_issues.actual: finishSession records the completed set and clears the session, but no session-summary-dialog is mounted. WorkoutModeView renders the 'Nessun allenamento attivo' state instead; the summary dialog count is 0. The reported root cause is that finishSession sets session to null while WorkoutModeView returns early at if (!session) before reaching the Dialog JSX, despite summary state being set.
integration_issues.impact: The new session-summary feature is unusable for every completed workout; volume, PRs, exercise details, and the required return-home action are inaccessible.

action_items: Keep the completed-session summary state renderable after finishSession clears the active session, for example by rendering the dialog before the !session early return or retaining the finished session context until summary close; verify total volume, PR count, exercise rows/PR badges, and summary-close-button navigation.
Resolve the reported lint errors in calendar.jsx and command.jsx and remove or correct unused eslint-disable directives in PlanEditorView.js, WorkoutModeView.js, and StoreContext.js.
Correct the StoreContext theme useEffect dependency handling and its lint suppression, then verify normal app load has no hooks warnings.
Retest the second same-day workout for overload chip/prefill, reload-based drag-order persistence, and isolated full CRUD in a clean browser/IndexedDB context.
checked_and_working: Public app loaded successfully at the configured preview URL with the seeded Inverno Split (PPL) plan, three days, and kg default.

Progressive overload worked in one isolated same-page flow: after completing Panca sets at 60 kg x 10 reps, restarting the same day showed overload-suggestion with +2.5kg and prefilled inspected sets at 62.5 kg x 8 reps.
Rest timer worked: completing a set displayed 2:00, +30s changed it to 2:30, and skip hid the timer.
Editor showed 12 required drag handles for seeded exercises and zero legacy up/down controls.
Dragging an exercise by its grip changed the visible exercise order; the reorder path was observed to call persistence.
Workout start, set input, and set completion controls worked.
Source review confirmed the overload path, summary calculation and PR data, editor CRUD controls, and Reorder persistence wiring are implemented.
not_reachable: Full session-summary contents, PR badges, and summary-close-button could not be validated because the dialog never renders after finish.

A reliable second completion of the same day, clean reload-and-reopen drag persistence assertion, and complete add-day/add-exercise/edit/delete CRUD pass were interrupted by concurrent runs sharing browser and IndexedDB state; no additional product bug is asserted from those interruptions.
additional_field: Three runs reported no backend testing because the app is intentionally frontend-only. The session-summary defect was independently reported by runs 1 and 2; the lint and theme-warning findings were reported by run 3.
